text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I-It must be an optical illusion... If I look again, surely it'll go back to—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No way...
The gloss of my hair is... gahh!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... It's all because of that shampoo.
I shouldn't have tried a new product...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
A queen's hair is supposed to be radiant, and yet......
